question: Once my Canadian trademark is registered, do I have to renew it to keep the registration active?
generated_answer: Trademarks are registered for 10 years and may be renewed indefinitely as long as the mark continues to be used in the Canadian marketplace. You must pay the renewal fee within the six-month window prior to the renewal deadline, or up to six months after, in which case a late fee will be applied.
